title: Transform
description: Change text without retyping it: case, numbers, joining lines, swapping and overwriting characters.

intro: Some edits are quicker as a transformation than as typing. Vim can change the case of text, do arithmetic on the number under the cursor, join lines, and swap or overwrite characters, all in place.
gU and gu are operators, so they take any motion or text object: gUiw shouts a word. ~ flips the case of one character.

commands.text: Make text uppercase. gu makes it lowercase.
Add one to the number under the cursor, or the next one on the line. <C-x> subtracts, and a count adds that much.
On a selection of lines, add one to the first number, two to the next and so on, which numbers a list.
Join the next line onto this one, with a space between.
Join the next line on without adding a space.
Delete the character under the cursor.
Swap two characters: x deletes one, and p puts it back after the next.
Overwrite: what you type replaces the text under it, one character at a time, until <Esc>.
Replace the one character under the cursor, and stay in Normal mode.

levels.title: Caps lock

levels.hint: gU is the uppercase operator. Give it a text object.

value: The password is hunter2, obviously. Don't tell anyone.

levels.hint: J joins lines with a space; gJ joins them without one.

levels.hint: x deletes a character and p puts it back after the cursor: xp swaps two characters.
